verdict.rationale: Milvus is a vector database, not an agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence only documents the reverse role: an MCP server that exposes Milvus to AI applications. That server belongs to a separate story and does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
